sourceSystem: local AI Compass with the development database (never production)
testData: church "Grace Fellowship (test)" only; made-up staff such as "Pat Example" with example.com addresses
writePolicy: test user, people, invites and responses created for the capture are removed afterwards; no real email is sent
note: Shell: no captures yet. Each entry matches a placeholder figure (data-shot) in the pages. A later run replaces each placeholder with the image and fills in processing.

images.shows: Home shows your church’s assessment: whether it is open, what to do next (for example Add your staff or Send the link), and how many people are on the list and have answered.
The sign-in page says “Sign in to manage your church’s staff assessment”, with the Email and Password boxes and the Sign in button.

images.screen: Left menu with account menu open
images.shows: The menu: Home, Staff list, Results and Questions, with the account menu open at the bottom showing Change password and Sign out.
The People section: the buttons Add a person, Add from a file and Edit the email, then each person’s name, email and status (Not sent, Link sent or Answered).
The Add a person box, with Name and Email filled in for a made-up person, and the Add person button.

images.screen: Staff list > Add from a file (first step)
images.shows: Add people from a file: the example table, the Download an example file link, the Choose a file button and the paste box.

images.screen: Staff list > Add from a file (row check)
images.shows: After the file is read: a summary line, then each row marked Will be added, Already on the list or Cannot be added (with the reason), and the Add button.
Editing a person: Name, Email, and the On the list tick box that takes them off the list when unticked.
The Questions page while the assessment is not open yet: the note about what you can change, the Preview as staff see it button, and a section of questions each with an Edit button.
Editing a standard question: Question, Helper line, How people answer (greyed out, “Set by DTS”), the choices, the two Options tick boxes and Save question.
Adding your own question: the note that it goes at the end, then Question, Helper line, How people answer, the choices and Add question.
After opening: the note that the questions are fixed, the Open the assessment page button, and no Edit buttons.

images.screen: Staff list, status box (not open yet)
images.shows: “The assessment is not open yet”, with the Open the assessment button and the note that DTS sets whether it is anonymous.
“The assessment is open”: Your church’s link with the Copy link button, and the Close the assessment button.
The email box: Subject, Message, the “Added every time” part (the privacy sentence, the button and the footer), and the Use the standard wording, Send me a test and Save buttons.
The People section once the assessment is open: the Email the N not yet sent it button, and rows marked Not sent and Link sent, each with a Send or Send again button.
A personal link for a made-up person, with the note that it works once and is shown this one time, and the Copy link and Done buttons.
“The assessment is closed”: the note that the link shows a closed message and answers are kept, and the Reopen the assessment button.
Everyone together: the number of responses, the Show answers from list, and a question’s bars with counts and percentages.
One response at a time: the list of responses, with one opened to show its answers under each section.
The assessment on a phone: the church’s name and “3 of 23 answered” at the top, and a question with its choices.
After sending: the Answers sent page with the church’s thank-you message.
What a link shows once the assessment is closed: “This survey has closed. Thank you for your interest.”

images.screen: Public church link of a tracked assessment
images.shows: The church link of a tracked assessment: a box for Your email address and the Send my link button.
